note: No definitive year found. The Bost conjecture (a variant of the Baum-Connes conjecture for ℓ¹ Banach algebras) appears to have been stated by Jean-Benoît Bost as a remark first documented in Lafforgue's 2002 paper 'K-théorie bivariante pour les algèbres de Banach et conjecture de Baum-Connes' (Inventiones Mathematicae 149:1-95). Bost likely communicated this conjecture to Lafforgue during his PhD supervision (1996-1999), but the exact year of original formulation is not documented in accessible sources. The conjecture is a specific variant related to but distinct from the Farrell-Jones conjecture (not a special case of it).
